{
  "name": "ruflo-agentdb",
  "description": "Substrate plugin for Ruflo memory: AgentDB controller bridge (15 agentdb_* MCP tools), RuVector ONNX embeddings (10 embeddings_* tools incl. RaBitQ 32x quantization), and WASM HNSW pattern router (3 ruvllm_hnsw_* tools). As a mod (ADR-445): opt-in safe recall into the prompt, a write guard that keeps secrets out of memory, /agentdb, and a status file the console shows",
  "version": "0.4.7",
  "author": {
    "name": "ruvnet",
    "url": "https://github.com/ruvnet"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "ruflo",
    "agentdb",
    "ruvector",
    "hnsw",
    "embeddings",
    "vector-search",
    "rabitq",
    "quantization",
    "namespace-convention",
    "controller-bridge",
    "mcp",
    "mod",
    "function-hooks",
    "recall",
    "guard"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "recall": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Recall into prompts",
      "description": "Attach the best few matching memories to each prompt as retrieved data. Off by default: it adds tokens to every prompt.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "on"
      ]
    },
    "recallLimit": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Memories per prompt",
      "description": "How many memories to attach, 1 to 5.",
      "required": false,
      "default": 3
    },
    "recallDeadlineMs": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Recall deadline (ms)",
      "description": "Give up and send the prompt without memory after this long, 200 to 3000.",
      "required": false,
      "default": 800
    },
    "guard": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Secret guard",
      "description": "Refuse memory writes that hold a key, token or password.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "source": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Memory source",
      "description": "Which connected tool to read: auto (AgentDB, then ruvector), agentdb, ruvector, or none.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "agentdb",
        "ruvector",
        "none"
      ]
    }
  }
}
